_about: Settings for the discovery track (finding possible new competitors). A different industry would replace this file, not the code.
market: Simulation-based training for healthcare workers (nursing, EMS, medical, allied health, behavioral health and counseling, military medical), especially interactive training on VR, AR, MR or XR headsets.

categories.label: 1st Degree
categories.definition: Trains healthcare workers (nursing, EMS, medical, allied health, behavioral health and counseling, military medical) AND offers INTERACTIVE training on a headset (VR, AR, MR or XR), even if the headset is one of several modes. Watching video or procedures in a headset is not interactive.

categories.label: 2nd Degree
categories.definition: Trains healthcare workers but has no interactive headset mode: screen-based virtual patients, manikins, task trainers, other simulation, or headset content that is watch-only (procedure viewing, 360-degree video).

categories.label: 3rd Degree
categories.definition: Interactive headset-based (VR, AR, MR or XR) training for police, fire, corrections or military that is not healthcare training. Security and de-escalation training for hospital security staff belongs here.

categories.label: Not Relevant
categories.definition: Anything else, including patient-facing VR (therapy, pain distraction, rehab), enterprise or industrial VR training, and healthcare software that is not training.

categories.label: Unclear
categories.definition: The saved pages do not show enough to decide. A person must look.

category_rules: Watch-only headset content (procedure viewing, 360-degree video) does not count as a headset mode. Decided by the owner 2026-09-29 (Immertec).
Behavioral health and counseling training counts as training healthcare workers. Decided 2026-09-29 (SimCare AI).
Hospital security de-escalation training is public-safety training (3rd Degree), not healthcare training. Decided 2026-09-29 (VirTra).
A company that trains both healthcare workers and public safety is placed by its healthcare side (1st or 2nd Degree). Decided 2026-09-29 (XVR).
